ambitionNote: Cards include study peers for brand-house path. Revenue/follower figures are observed claims from sources — never VORG forecasts.

cards.observedFact: GQ reported a Brooklyn denim-exchange scene with intense city participation and event energy.
cards.transferableMechanism: City-specific participation around a product exchange / densim moment, measured with RSVP and controlled capacity.
cards.vorgHypothesis: If Brooklyn is later chosen for a pop-up, run a booked, capacity-capped fit/try event after online metro proof—not a street mob.
cards.controlledTest: After online receipts, one RSVP-gated Brooklyn try-on with hard capacity and photo consent.

cards.observedFact: Brand positions products, editorial, community language, and physical experience as one world.
cards.transferableMechanism: Keep Drop 001 SKUs, content, and any later pop-up inside one coherent brand world.
cards.vorgHypothesis: Firm Jacket + denim + scarf should share one visual/language system across TikTok, YouTube, and Shopify.
cards.controlledTest: Publish one product-truth YouTube cut + three TikToks + one Shopify PDP set that share identical fit claims and imagery rules.

cards.observedFact: Shopify case study highlights founder-led trust and connected Shopify/POS pop-up operations at mature scale.
cards.transferableMechanism: Founder long-form trust content feeding a Shopify checkout path, with POS reconciliation if a pop-up happens later.
disallowedCopy: treat mature revenue as VORG benchmark
assume pop-up sales before venue proof
cards.vorgHypothesis: Founder YouTube is a product-truth library; short cuts feed TikTok; Shopify owns checkout measurement.
cards.controlledTest: Ship three founder fit/fabric clips, cut shorts, land on one U.S.-priced Shopify page, measure qualified product/size/city actions.

cards.observedFact: TikTok case material describes native creator/employee content connected to Shopify with measured experimentation.
cards.transferableMechanism: Original native short-form + measured Shopify landing tests.
disallowedCopy: treat platform case ROAS as expected VORG ROAS
cards.vorgHypothesis: Employee/founder-native clips outperform scripted praise for a new micro-label.
cards.controlledTest: Run a capped creative sprint with kill rules on qualified actions, not views.

cards.observedFact: TikTok case material emphasizes creator freedom and native format testing.
cards.transferableMechanism: Give creators format freedom inside a signed brief with disclosure, claims, and music controls.
cards.vorgHypothesis: One contracted/gift-disclosed U.S. creator test can beat ten vague seeding DMs.
cards.controlledTest: One signed creator brief + disclosure checklist + outcome receipt before any scale.

cards.observedFact: Editorial sources describe founder-as-channel storytelling, a coherent Southern-France visual world, and runway/settings designed for social shareability; GQ cites independent Paris scale and retail rollout at mature revenue.
cards.transferableMechanism: One irreducible brand world + founder personal channel + image discipline where every asset reinforces the same place/story/product grammar.
disallowedCopy: using peer revenue as VORG target
claiming luxury adjacency without craft proof
cards.vorgHypothesis: VORG wins by making The Firm / Originals world as recognizable as a color/place code — not by copying Provence aesthetics.
cards.controlledTest: Lock 3 must / 3 never image rules; shoot one lookbook set that obeys them; cold-test recognition without logo.

cards.observedFact: Founder-duo brand built from small start capital; podcast/community/events sit beside product; retail share grew after online; US pop-ups followed organic US demand claims in interviews.
cards.transferableMechanism: Community media (long-form conversation) + in-person events after demand exists; retail follows data.
disallowedCopy: podcast as empty content without community
treating reported multi-million revenue as VORG baseline
cards.vorgHypothesis: A VORG product-truth podcast/YouTube series can build trust before retail; US pop-up only after Brooklyn online receipts.
cards.controlledTest: Four founder long-form episodes tied to SKU fit questions; measure waitlist/size captures, not downloads alone.

cards.observedFact: Strategy profiles describe vertical control, craft capacity limits, owned retail, and full-price discipline rather than promotional scarcity theatre.
cards.transferableMechanism: At micro scale: price integrity, claim restraint, scarcity as byproduct of real capacity/QC — not fake sold-out.
cards.vorgHypothesis: VORG earns Hermès-like trust only after repeated QC and honest materials — Phase 0 is claim ladder + sample truth.
cards.controlledTest: Publish zero unproven luxury adjectives; every fibre/finish claim maps to a quote or sample photo.

cards.observedFact: Vogue Business reports DTC-led growth, trend-led drops, organic stylist/celebrity demand around a hero parachute-pant silhouette; US share and pop-ups followed demand.
cards.transferableMechanism: One hero silhouette that becomes requestable; DTC-first; physical retail after territory proves itself.
cards.vorgHypothesis: Firm Jacket or women’s low-rise can be the requestable hero if fit is proven — then denim compounds.
cards.controlledTest: Pick one hero; run all Wave-0 content on that hero’s fit truth; measure stylist/creator request rate and PDP actions.

cards.observedFact: FashionUnited/Shopify case material describe community-named tribe, limited drops, organic/direct traffic emphasis, and retail after online validation across EU markets.
cards.transferableMechanism: Named community + drop discipline + expand geography only after online data.
cards.vorgHypothesis: Name a small VORG circle (seed/waitlist tier) with real obligations; grow organic before paid.
cards.controlledTest: Define seed circle rules (15–20) with disclosure + outcome fields; no paid until circle produces qualified actions.

cards.observedFact: FashionUnited/FashionNetwork report Spanish digital-first growth, drop/pop-up culture, measured internationalization via temporary NYC base before permanent leaps; founders describe slowing drop cadence for quality.
cards.transferableMechanism: Drop-as-event + temporary market tests before permanent retail; slow cadence when quality demands it.
disallowedCopy: treating €33M peer revenue as VORG plan
cards.vorgHypothesis: Brooklyn online proof → time-boxed pop-up → only then discuss permanence.
cards.controlledTest: One drop calendar with kill rules; pop-up only after metro receipts and venue package.
